subject: Recap: Compliance-first MPA & legal timeline — confirmation and owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@aureusbio.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@aureusbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Compliance-first MPA & legal timeline — confirmation and owners

Hi Evan / Priya —

Thanks again for carving out 30 minutes today. Quick recap so we all have the same page and clear next steps. If I missed anything, please flag.

Top pain points you shared:
- Need for strict data isolation (PHI-in-scope) and dedicated VPC or on-prem option for inference.
- Procurement and legal require SOC 2 artifacts, data residency statements, and a short security questionnaire answered within 7 business days.
- Concern about inference latency for interactive clinician workflows (target: <350ms 95th).

Primary goals:
1) Run a 4-week pilot with a private (VPC) deployment and a small dedicated GPU pool.
2) Validate throughput and end-to-end latency with a synthetic clinician sample set.
3) Receive SOC 2 evidence and contractual terms to move to procurement by mid-November.

Proposed mutual action plan (draft attached: redwood_mpa_draft_v1.pdf):
- Milestone A — Security pack & NDA: Redwood provides SOC 2 summary + answers to questionnaire (owner: Marissa) — target: 2026-10-27
- Milestone B — Technical kickoff + requirements sheet: Engineering sync to confirm model size, traffic pattern, and latency SLOs (owner: Karthik) — target: 2026-10-29
- Milestone C — Pilot deployment & smoke tests: Dedicated VPC pilot with 2-weeks of validation (owner: Aureus IT; Redwood support: Ben) — start target: 2026-11-01
- Milestone D — Procurement package delivered (SOW + pricing + SLA): Redwood to provide final SOW and pricing for procurement lane (owner: Ben) — target: 2026-11-12

Asks for you: please confirm the internal stakeholders who will be approvers for the procurement lane (legal, procurement, IT security), and whether the 2-week pilot cadence works given your regulatory calendar.

Attachments: SOC 2 summary (soc2-summary-2025.pdf) and draft MPA (redwood_mpa_draft_v1.pdf). I also pasted a one-page timeline below for easy reference.

One-page timeline (high-level):
2026-10-27 — Security pack delivered
2026-10-29 — Technical kickoff
2026-11-01 — Pilot deploy begins
2026-11-12 — SOW + pricing to procurement

Next steps: I’ll queue the SOC 2 artifact and the short questionnaire now and drop a calendar invite for the technical kickoff on 10/29 (30 minutes).

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: redwood_mpa_draft_v1.pdf (11 pages), soc2-summary-2025.pdf (2 pages)
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@aureusbio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aureusbio.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Compliance-first MPA & legal timeline — confirmation and owners

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear write-up. That matches our discussion. A few clarifications from our side:
- Approvers: Legal (Priya Shah) and Procurement (Christine Park, procurement@aureusbio.com). IT Security (myself) will run the pilot acceptance tests.
- Timeline: The dates look good; procurement needs final pricing and a simple SOW by 11/12 to make the November exec meeting. If the SOC 2 pack is available by 10/27, Legal will start their review immediately.
- Pilot scope: We can start with 2 GPU instances and up to 500 concurrent requests/day for test traffic. The latency SLO of <350ms 95th is achievable if we do a small caching warm-up — we will validate during the first 48 hours of the pilot.

One ask: can Redwood provide a redline-friendly SOW (Word doc) and a short clause around data residency for our legal team?

I’m available for the 10/29 tech kickoff. Priya — looping you for legal/contract confirmation.

Best,
Evan
Evan Liu
Director, IT Security | Aureus Biotech
evan.liu@aureusbio.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Compliance-first MPA & legal timeline — confirmation and owners

Marissa — quick internal note.

We can fast-track the SOC 2 artifact pack and produce a redline-friendly SOW by EOD 2026-10-28. Legal has asked for a short NDA before handing anything that contains operational details; can you confirm if Aureus will sign the standard Redwood mutual NDA? I can send the DocuSign link once I have the go-ahead.

Also proposed commercial note: given the regulatory urgency we can offer a pilot support credit (15% off pilot labor) if procurement signs within the target date. I’ll hold that as a one-time concession under deal RDW-2026-287 pending your confirmation.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@aureusbio.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@aureusbio.com>, Christine Park <procurement@aureusbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized MPA timeline & next actions (DocuSign + technical kickoff invite)

Hi all —

Thanks for the confirmations, Evan. Below is the finalized mutual action plan with concrete owners and dates. I’ve also included immediate asks so Legal and Procurement can keep momentum.

Finalized MPA (milestones with owners & dates):
- 2026-10-27 — SOC 2 artifact + questionnaire answers (Owner: Marissa Cole | Redwood). Attachment: soc2-summary-2025.pdf
- 2026-10-28 — NDA sent for signature via DocuSign (Owner: Ben Carter | Redwood) — DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/some-sow-link
- 2026-10-29 — Technical kickoff (Owner: Karthik Iyer | Redwood) — calendar invite sent (30 min)
- 2026-11-01 — Pilot deployment begins (Owner: Aureus IT) — Redwood will provision dedicated VPC and 2 GPU nodes
- 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-14 — Pilot validation window; Redwood to run smoke tests and latency reports (Owner: Karthik + Aureus IT)
- 2026-11-12 — Final SOW + pricing submitted to procurement (Owner: Ben Carter | Redwood)

Immediate asks for Aureus: 
1) Legal to confirm NDA signature path (Priya / Christine) so Ben can send the DocuSign.
2) Procurement to confirm budget holder and whether a PO will be required immediately after SOW (Christine).
3) Aureus IT to confirm the sample traffic file and any IP whitelisting needed for the VPC (Evan).

Commercial note: Ben will apply a 15% pilot-support credit if procurement signs by 2026-11-12 (applies to labor/support only, not infrastructure).

I’ve attached the draft MPA and SOC 2 summary again for convenience. If we get NDA signed by 10/28, we should be able to hit the pilot start date.

Thanks — will follow up with the DocuSign once Ben confirms.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: redwood_mpa_draft_v1.pdf, soc2-summary-2025.pdf
